skill.name: webask-workspace-housekeeping
skill.description: Наводит порядок в аккаунте WebAsk: раскладывает опросы по папкам, архивирует отработавшие, возвращает из корзины, копирует под новую волну, делает шаблон из удачного опроса, чистит файлы. Применяется, когда человек просит прибраться, разложить опросы, убрать старое, скопировать опрос или сохранить его как шаблон.
skill.summary: Organize WebAsk surveys, preserve past responses, prepare new survey rounds, and manage workspace files with explicit deletion approval.
skill.author: webaskio

security_audit.summary: All 21 static findings are false positives: documentation links are not filesystem traversal, and Markdown tool names are not shell execution. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or unauthorized data transfer in the reviewed files. Destructive WebAsk operations require explicit approval in the instructions; external tool implementations and enforcement are outside this review.

remediation.issue: The README labels survey deletion irreversible, while the skill describes recoverable trash; its prose also omits irreversible folder deletion.
remediation.suggestion: Align README deletion descriptions with verified tool behavior, distinguishing survey trash from permanent deletion of files and folders.

content.value_statement: Crowded WebAsk workspaces make completed surveys, active projects, and reusable templates difficult to manage. This skill guides approved cleanup, survey duplication, archiving, and file management through WebAsk MCP tools.
actual_capabilities: Lists workspaces, folders, and surveys to prepare a cleanup plan for user approval.
Guides folder creation, renaming, ordering, and survey moves, names, and notes.
Archives completed surveys and uses response summaries to check for ongoing collection.
Moves unwanted surveys to trash and restores surveys using the documented recovery tool.
Duplicates surveys for new rounds and creates reusable templates without editing previous rounds.
Inspects workspace storage and lists files by survey or type before explicitly approved deletion.
limitations: Requires access to a configured WebAsk MCP connection and the relevant workspace tools.
Provides assistant instructions, not tool implementations or independently enforced approval controls.
Permanent file deletion cannot be reversed; folder deletion can also remove contents.
Comprehensive account health audits are outside scope, and plan limits stop work without payment recommendations.

use_cases.title: Organize Shared Survey Folders
use_cases.description: Prepare an approved folder structure and organize team surveys while checking permission before changing colleagues' surveys.

use_cases.title: Prepare Recurring Research Rounds
use_cases.description: Copy a completed survey into a new folder and create templates while preserving previous responses.

use_cases.title: Review Workspace Storage
use_cases.description: Inspect storage use, list candidate files, and approve specific permanent deletions after reviewing their consequences.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Workspace
prompt_templates.prompt: List the surveys and folders in my WebAsk workspace. Suggest an organization plan without changing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Organize Completed Surveys
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose folders for my completed surveys. Check recent responses before suggesting archives, and wait for my approval before making changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: plan folder changes and archives.

prompt_templates.title: Create a New Survey Round
prompt_templates.prompt: Duplicate [survey name] into [folder] as [new round name]. Preserve the original and its responses, and ask me to resolve ambiguous survey names.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Cleanup and Storage Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [workspace] for folder organization, completed survey archives, reusable templates, and storage cleanup. Present exact targets and consequences, then request approval. Confirm permanent deletions separately.

output_examples.input: Show a proposed cleanup plan before making changes.
output: Example plan: archive six completed surveys and move twelve obsolete drafts to trash.
Convert one recurring survey into a reusable template.
Leave surveys with recent responses unchanged.
No changes made. Please approve the listed targets before execution.

output_examples.input: Prepare a new round from the approved survey without changing last round.
output: Example result after successful tool execution: the survey copy is in the requested folder with the new round name.
The original survey and its previous responses remain unchanged.

output_examples.input: Review old respondent files before deleting anything.
output: Example storage review: archived surveys contain 3.4 GB of respondent files.
Review the specific file list and confirm deletion separately. No files have been deleted.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace and exact survey or file targets before approving changes.
Check recent responses before archiving, and duplicate surveys when preparing new rounds.
Review permanent deletions separately and obtain permission before modifying colleagues' surveys.
anti_patterns: Treating a general cleanup request as approval to permanently delete files or folders.
Archiving surveys that still collect responses.
Editing a previous survey round instead of creating a separate copy.

faq.question: What must be connected before using this skill?
faq.answer: A WebAsk MCP connection must expose the required tools and provide access to the intended workspace.

faq.question: Does a general cleanup request immediately change my workspace?
faq.answer: The instructions require a proposed action list and user consent before general cleanup.

faq.question: What happens when a survey is archived?
faq.answer: The skill describes archiving as preserving data while removing the survey from the main list and stopping access through its link.

faq.question: Can deleted items be restored?
faq.answer: The skill describes survey trash as recoverable through restore_quiz. Files deleted permanently cannot be restored, and folder deletion is also marked irreversible.

faq.question: Can I reuse a survey without changing previous responses?
faq.answer: The workflow duplicates the original into a new round. Recurring surveys can also become reusable templates.

faq.question: Does this skill execute local shell commands?
faq.answer: No local shell commands are defined in the reviewed files. The backticked names refer to MCP tools that can modify WebAsk data.
